The ColorVerse method

A palette is only
the beginning.

01

Brief

Give the system a job: a product family, a space, a screen, or a public-facing identity.

02

System

Assign roles and rules so color carries hierarchy, recognition, and rhythm across the set.

03

Surface

Test the direction on material, light, type, and scale before calling it finished.

About ColorVerse studies

Everything on this page is an original fictional design exercise made for ColorVerse. It is not a real client, product claim, or item for sale. The point is to make color decisions tangible, editable, and useful.
